formulas.ascii: Predicate of the monotone chain, not the chain: coordinates are snapped to an integer lattice q = floor(s (p - p_min) + 1/2) with one power-of-two scale s so the data extent spans 2^29 steps, and orient(a, b, c) = sign((b_x - a_x)(c_y - a_y) - (b_y - a_y)(c_x - a_x)) is evaluated exactly with emulated 64-bit integers. Rows are sorted by (label, x, y); the chain pops the last vertex while orient <= 0, so collinear points are never hull vertices. The vertices returned are the original float32 positions, counter-clockwise from the smallest (x, y).

snapshots.name: groupIds
snapshots.meaning: Cluster slot index (nominal), the colour of each outline

snapshots.name: sizes
snapshots.meaning: True hull vertex count per cluster

snapshots.name: counts
snapshots.meaning: Emitted hull vertex count per cluster

snapshots.name: overflow
snapshots.meaning: Overflow bits: 1 when a hull was too large, 2 when the vertex list was full

snapshots.name: offsets
snapshots.meaning: First vertex slot of each cluster hull

snapshots.name: vertexPositions
snapshots.meaning: Convex hull vertices of each cluster, counter-clockwise (m)
